class.name: Telegram
class.description: Reads Telegram WebApp init data, theme, viewport, and safe area, and can send data back to the bot.

method.name: get_init_data
method.description: Returns the signed Telegram init data.

method.name: get_safe_area
method.description: Returns the Telegram safe area insets.

method.name: request_fullscreen
method.description: Asks Telegram to expand the mini app.

method.name: send_data
method.description: Sends a string back to the Telegram bot.
